text:
Natalie (PM): quick design review — small follow-ups on the playground streaming controls. dropped a short vid + 3 copy options: https://img.redwood.dev/s/stream-clip.mp4 Sam (Design): watching now. thanks! can you TL;DR the options? Natalie (PM): sure — Option A: 'Stop' (simple), Option B: 'Stop & Regenerate' (explicit about regen), Option C: two buttons: 'Stop' + 'Regenerate' separated. also thinking about token counter behavior during stream + keyboard shortcut UX. Sam (Design): my gut = Option B for primary action when streaming (users expect regen after stop). Option C is ok but feels heavier in compact composer. Kai (Eng): agree on B. also a11y concern: when stream is interrupted we should announce final state to screen readers (aria-live). we currently only announce tokens when complete. Ellie (UX): +1 on announcing state change. microcopy suggestion: instead of 'Stopped' maybe 'Stopped — draft saved' when stopping mid-stream (helps clarify tokens/partial result). Sam (Design): ooh — 'Stopped — draft saved' feels friendlier. also token counter placement: do we freeze the counter at last emitted token or keep counting attempted tokens until regen? Natalie (PM): proposal: freeze at emission. show small faded indicator 'paused at 124 tokens' and retain total estimate once regenerate completes. keeps metric stable for billing visibility. Kai (Eng): freezing is easiest. implementation: stop streaming loop and snapshot token_count. will need to ensure KV cache is consistent. Ellie (UX): keyboard shortcuts: users ask for ESC to stop streaming. we currently use ESC to close composer. maybe use Shift+ESC to stop? thoughts. Sam (Design): prefer dedicated shortcut: Cmd/Ctrl+K is used elsewhere. what about Cmd/Ctrl+\.(dot) for stop? short, thumb-friendly. Kai (Eng): avoid key combos that conflict with browsers. Shift+Esc is safe but weird. we can expose configurable shortcut in settings later; for now map to Esc with focus on composer only (so it doesn't close entire pane). Natalie (PM): good point. composer-scoped Esc for stop, global Esc still closes modals. add a subtle tooltip 'Press Esc to stop' during stream. Ellie (UX): accessibility copy — add aria-label to stop btn: 'Stop streaming response (press Esc)'. and set role="status" on the final message container so screen readers announce completion. Kai (Eng): snippet for aria we can use: ```
Response complete — stopped at 124 tokens
``` Sam (Design): looks good. one microcopy nit: 'Response complete' vs 'Streaming complete' — which is clearer? Ellie (UX): 'Response complete' focuses on result; 'Streaming complete' is techy. go with 'Response complete'. redwood-bot: checklist created: [a11y announce, freeze token counter, composer-scoped Esc, stop btn aria-label, copy: 'Stop & Regenerate' primary]. Natalie (PM): thanks — small follow-ups: 1) update prompt library button when streaming (grey out insert actions until stream stops), 2) token tooltip should explain billing vs preview tokens, 3) add a11y note in docs. Sam (Design): I'll update the mock with Option B + 'Stopped — draft saved' state and token freeze microcopy. will post new frames by EOD. Kai (Eng): i'll plan a short PR for the aria bits + token snapshot. ETA tomorrow morning. Ellie (UX): I'll write the microcopy variants (short, friendly, and formal) and post for final pick. Natalie (PM): perfect — thanks everyone. leaving this thread open for any last nits. :thumbsup: Sam (Design): one last nit — for small screens, prefer single 'Stop & Regenerate' button only if width > 420px; otherwise only show 'Stop' and a smaller regen icon. adding to mock.
